title: Turning on the Taps
summary:
Turning on the Taps
When considering crude production in West Africa, it is often a first inclination to consider what is not being produced. Civil unrest and other supply disruptions, specifically in Nigeria, have been the focus of attention for several months. The reality is that as this region is becoming increasingly important for meeting global oil demand, many of the producers are stepping up to the task.

children.title: Ensuring Supply
children.summary: While disruptions in Nigeria have plagued many of the long-existing channels, replacement supply has recently started to come through other terminals in Nigeria, Erha and Bonga in particular. As the region regains lost production more cargoes will flow from these African nations.
